claims.evidence: Location and availability cannot be confirmed from the photo; witness report shows only the item, not its location or current availability.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or function (motor, spinner, drum condition unknown)
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine being plugged in and run through a wash/spin cycle

risks.risk: Missing accessories (inlet/outlet hoses, lid, control knobs, detergent tray)
risks.proof: Photos of the back of the unit and a close-up of the control panel and hose connections
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, missing standard accessories

risks.risk: Hidden rust, leaks, or cracks on unseen sides/base
risks.proof: Photos from rear, underside, and both side panels
Close-up photo of the rating plate/serial sticker showing model number and capacity
risks.if_unproven: priced at lowest typical capacity/model tier for Nexus single-tub units

risks.proof: Purchase receipt or seller statement with verifiable date, or visible wear patterns in additional photos
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, older stock

proof_requests: Video of machine powering on and completing a wash/spin cycle
Clear photo of the rating plate/model number and capacity label
Photos of the rear panel, hose connections, and underside
Close-up of control panel and knobs
Any photos showing age/wear (drum interior, rust spots, cracks)
response.reason: The witness confirms a Nexus washing machine, so it can be priced at worst case (untested, possibly incomplete) pending functional and condition proof.
